name: Pre-Visit History
outcome: Collect a patient's reported history before arrival and prepare a structured brief for the clinician to review.
required_inputs: Authenticated clinic context in any production deployment
outputs: Structured history brief with source labels
guardrails: Do not diagnose, triage, recommend medication, or prescribe.
Never overwrite original patient answers with a summary or correction.
Label missing, contradictory, uncertain, and clinician-entered information distinctly.
Current demo data must remain synthetic.
activation_requirements: Qualified clinician must review and approve the questionnaire.
Production identity, access control, tenant isolation, privacy, security, retention and deletion controls must pass review.
A staff member must be able to review and correct the brief with an audit trail.
